title: Synthesis — Señalización estándar
description: A whole-board proposal following real-transit signage conventions: the scheduled clock time under each countdown, the imminent departure lifted into a raised accent panel, a 'Hoy ·' relative date anchor, and a pluralized column label.

changes.intent: Derive the scheduled clock time to show beneath the countdown.
changes.detail: Add a detail-only `scheduledTime = format(now + etaMinutes, 'HH:mm')` using the same toLocaleTimeString('es-CR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:false}) as the header clock.

changes.intent: Stack countdown over the muted clock time.
changes.detail: Wrap .arrival-row__eta plus a new .arrival-row__eta-scheduled span inside a new .arrival-row__eta-group container. Rows in 'ahora'/'SALIENDO' render only their existing label, no stacked clock line. Hours format (1 h 4 min) stays as the top line.

changes.intent: Secondary supporting detail, not competing with the countdown.
Raise the imminent-departure row into an accented panel.
Enlarge the lead row's headsign so it reads first.
Scale the SALIENDO label up with the lead row.
Prefix the abbreviated date with a relative 'Hoy' anchor.
changes.detail: Add a static 'Hoy' relativePrefix combined as `${relativePrefix} · ${abbrevDate}` where abbrevDate uses short weekday/month ('Dom 23 ago'), producing 'Hoy · Dom 23 ago'.

changes.intent: Ink the relative cue against the muted date.
Match the label to the multi-row content.
changes.detail: Change the second header span text from 'Próxima salida' to 'Próximas salidas'.
